previous_statement: Involution and unit. The involution-compatibility clause in the four-corner datum is the exact source condition gamma_kj,n(X^dagger)=gamma_jk,n(X)^dagger; decomposing X into its four corners and reindexing therefore gives gamma_n(X^dagger)=gamma_n(X)^dagger exactly. Also gamma_n(I)=gamma_11,n(I_n tensor Pi_1)+gamma_22,n(I_n tensor Pi_2); the two diagonal-unit bounds and target complementarity give ||gamma_n(I)-I||<=3rho (with harmless universal enlargement if complementarity is recorded under the common bound), hence at most 3e.
new_statement: Involution and unit. The common involution-compatibility defect in def-four-corner-merging-datum and the exact source corner decomposition imply ||gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger||<=4rho||X||. Also gamma_n(I)=gamma_11,n(I_n tensor Pi_1)+gamma_22,n(I_n tensor Pi_2); the two diagonal-unit bounds and target complementarity give ||gamma_n(I)-I||<=3rho (or the same conclusion with a harmless universal enlargement when complementarity is included in the common defect bound). Thus both defects are at most universal multiples of e=rho+epsilon, uniformly in n.
